A FEW THINGS TO KNOW

Good questions.
Clear answers.

Is Funding Empire a lender?

No. Funding Empire is a connection service, not a lender. Lending decisions, pricing, and repayment agreements belong to the provider.

Am I guaranteed an offer or approval?

No. Submitting an inquiry does not guarantee a match, an offer, approval, or funding. Providers set their own eligibility requirements.

Does this inquiry check my credit?

This form does not perform a credit check. A provider may perform checks if you continue with them; review their disclosures before proceeding.

What happens to my information?

In this preview, submission is disabled. Once configured, the inquiry is sent to Funding Empire’s private Google Sheet for follow-up. Partner links take you to separate sites with their own privacy policies.

Are all providers available in my state?

Availability varies by provider and location. Confirm state eligibility and the complete costs on the provider’s website.

fe↗fundingempireA little clarity goes a long way.

We are not lenders. We connect borrowers with lending providers. Funding Empire does not issue credit, make lending decisions, or set APRs, fees, or repayment schedules. No approval or funding is guaranteed. Provider availability varies by state.
